answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because ripple only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice vertex is enforced by the ledger itself: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any oasis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
